notes: Producer Microsoft Print to PDF (GDI) driven from PowerShell PrintDocument; Arabic drawn with StringFormat DirectionRightToLeft so GDI+ shapes and orders it. Arial and Arial Bold as embedded TrueType subsets. The author did NOT inspect the result visually. The items table is right-to-left and ONE table continued over the page break, header row redrawn on page 2: its columns from the RIGHT edge are م (number), البند (item), الكمية (quantity), سعر الوحدة (unit price), الإجمالي (total); rows list cells in logical order, rightmost first. The last three rows (المجموع الفرعي, ضريبة القيمة المضافة (15%), الإجمالي المستحق) have the label spanning the first four columns, so the label is repeated in those four cells. The top key/value block has labels ending in a colon (part of the visible label) and no header row. The two boxes (بيانات العميل on the right, عنوان التسليم on the left) are read right box first; each has a level-3 heading and one sentence. Lettered markers are typed Arabic letters with a parenthesis; the nested lines use a typed hyphen. Numbers are Western digits; amounts use a decimal point and comma thousands. The text 'ختم الشركة وتوقيعها' is a caption inside a drawn stamp box (furniture). The letterhead name is not a heading.
